card.fires_on: Digits inside photographer or era dates, and small words or punctuation just before a photo, image or media mention, such as a colon after "Image" or "Commons" before "has media". Mostly general web text.

modes.label: Digits in year ranges
modes.description: A digit inside a year span tied to photography, such as a photographer's lifespan or a photo era.

modes.label: Image credit colon
modes.description: The colon right after "Image" in a photo caption, before the credit.

modes.label: Media-related phrases
modes.description: Linking words in phrases about media or supplementary materials that come before a mention of pictures or files.

card.writes: It suppresses words for pictures and photographs, so it holds back image words as the next word.
card.plain: It fires where a photo or image caption or credit is about to appear, and it lowers the chance the text says picture or photograph next.
